purpose: Document first-party discovery, current public land-record routes, bounded anonymous access review, and evidence limits.
assessment: TKGM's official Parsel Sorgu documentation and app listing establish a public national parcel viewer with administrative, coordinate, and map-based search, basic parcel attributes, and geographic coordinates. The official Elazığ regional-office page establishes the local Tapu Müdürlüğü custodian. The current accessible pages did not expose a machine-readable service configuration or anonymous ID-plus-geometry response, so no geometry sample is retained and runtime readiness is held.
registryAssessment: A local registry/cadastre custodian is evidenced by the official TKGM Elazığ regional-office page naming Elazığ Tapu Müdürlüğü. This supports registryFound=true, but does not establish open citywide geometry access or integration readiness.
